GSAT 502.course_name: Advanced Concepts in Genome Science and Technology
GSAT 502.description: Current approaches to high-throughput, system-wide analysis, and manipulation of biological systems. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GSAT 503.course_name: Directed Studies in Genome Science and Technology
GSAT 503.description: Advanced study under the direction of a faculty member composed of laboratory sessions and/or directed readings related to selected areas of genome science and technology. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
